path_conditions: cpt_device_init() is called from cpt_probe(), which is the PCI driver .probe callback installed in cpt_pci_driver. PCI .probe callbacks run in process context and are therefore sleepable; the 100 ms busy-wait via mdelay(100) wastes CPU cycles and should be replaced by msleep(100). The bug fits the 'delay-gfp' pattern: a busy-wait (atomic-only) primitive used where a sleeping equivalent is correct.
